refined_prompt: Full-body character design of a compact Western wyvern-type dragon in aggressive crouching pose, facing viewer at slight angle. Stocky muscular build like a pit bull crossed with a bat, low to the ground. Charcoal-black and deep crimson scales, battle-scarred with cracked and chipped armor plating across chest and shoulders. Thick armored tail with spiked mace-like tip raised aggressively. Smoke curling from nostrils and between scales where inner fire glows through cracks. Off-center composition on clean background. Hard top-down lighting with warm rim light from below suggesting volcanic heat. Gritty detailed rendering style reminiscent of dark fantasy concept art. Heavy textured brushwork. Intimidating feral silhouette.
